Good morning, this is the beach report for Monday. The water temperature is eighteen degrees, so you still want a wetsuit. The swell comes from the south and it drops through the afternoon. High tide is at ten past seven, and the best spot at that time is the north end, near the rocks. The lifeguard tower opens at seven and it closes at five. One warning: the wind picks up after midday and it makes the water messy. Get in early.

My name is Emma and I live ten minutes from the beach. On school days I get up at half past five. I never eat before I surf, but I always drink water. My brother comes with me and he carries the gear, because he loses every argument. We paddle out at six and we stay for one hour. Then I go home, I have a shower, and I catch the bus at half past seven. My friends think I am crazy. I think they sleep too much.
